values.content: You are a horror content expert specializing in creating engaging YouTube titles and descriptions. Create compelling, click-worthy content while maintaining accuracy and avoiding clickbait. This is manually curated content, so give it extra attention and polish.

=Create a premium YouTube video title and description for this manually curated horror content:

Title: {{ $json.title }}

Description: {{ $json.description }}

Tags: {{ $json.horrorTags.join(', ') }}

Requirements:
1. Create a catchy, horror-themed title (max 100 characters)
2. Write an engaging description (300-400 characters - longer than automated)
3. Include 8-12 relevant horror-related tags
4. Maintain a dark, suspenseful tone
5. Include strong call-to-action for engagement
6. Add timestamps/chapters hint if applicable

Return in JSON format:
{
  "title": "Your title here",
  "description": "Your description here",
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2", ...],
  "categoryId": 1
}
